paragraphs: Yose bar Ashyan: [Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah, chapter 4, halakhah 6](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Sukkah.4.6.4); Rav Yitzchak bar Ashyan: [Berakhot 14a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.14a.16-17).[^1][^2]

notes.text: Yose bar Ashyan speaks in Resh Lakish’s name in the linked Yerushalmi. [Heilprin’s entry on Yose](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1957&lang=en) cites the same teaching.

The linked Bavli spells Yitzchak’s name אשיאן and gives two statements that Rav Idi bar Avin transmits in his name. See [Heilprin’s entry on Yitzchak](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2200&lang=en).
